components.purpose: Intrinsic subject appeal for Pokemon cards

components.missingnessRule: Unavailable subject evidence remains unavailable; it is not inferred from price

components.formula: 40% today 12-m + 60% today 5-y within-Trainer percentile authority; set lift=(100-D_pokemon)*0.15*D_trainer/100
components.missingnessRule: Only legitimate named identities score; generic or unresolved roles remain unavailable
components.refreshCadence: 12-m: 7 days; 5-y: 31 days; identity metadata: catalog change

components.purpose: Bounded secondary recognition lift after subject and Playability
components.formula: after_playability + (100-after_playability)*0.10*(artist_appeal/100); Artist authority is 40% today 12-m + 60% today 5-y
components.missingnessRule: Missing is neutral (no lift, no penalty); confirmed zero remains numeric zero; multi-artist uses the maximum independently scoreable artist and never sums
components.refreshCadence: 12-m: 7 days; 5-y: 31 days; identity metadata: catalog change
components.knownLimitation: No direct collector-preference voting; recognition is an imperfect proxy
